join.joinCondition: t1.person_id = person_name.person_id AND (person_name.voided IS NULL || person_name.voided = 0) AND person_name.preferred = 1
t1.person_id = contacts.person_id AND (contacts.voided IS NULL || contacts.voided = 0) AND contacts.person_attribute_type_id = 71

expressionOptions.expression: CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t1.birthdate, CURDATE()) / 12), ' ', MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t1.birthdate, CURDATE()), 12), '/12')

columns.column: (SELECT COALESCE(v.value_numeric, CAST(NULLIF(v.value_text, '') AS DECIMAL(12, 4))) FROM amrs.obs v WHERE v.person_id = t1.person_id AND v.concept_id = 5089 AND v.voided = 0 ORDER BY (v.encounter_id = et.encounter_id) DESC, v.obs_datetime DESC, v.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
